service.description: The current user's chat preferences with their defaults: enterSends (CHAT_ENTER_SENDS, Y: Enter sends and Shift+Enter is a new line; N: Ctrl+Enter sends), sounds (CHAT_SOUNDS, Y), readReceipts (CHAT_READ_RECEIPTS, Y), typing (CHAT_TYPING, Y: send and show typing), linkPreviews (CHAT_LINK_PREVIEWS, Y: the framework fetches the previews of the links the user sends; N: none), notifyDefault (CHAT_NOTIFY_DEFAULT: all, mentions or none for the rooms the user makes or joins, which the framework's ChatServices start a membership at; empty for the room's own default), notifyPreview (CHAT_NOTIFY_PREVIEW, Y: a mention's notification has the message text; N: only who mentioned the user where, read by the framework's notify#Mention), autoAwayMinutes (CHAT_AUTO_AWAY_MINUTES, 10, which the framework's presence reads), dndFrom and dndTo (CHAT_DND_FROM and CHAT_DND_TO, HH:mm in the user's time zone, apply#DndHours), dndAllowed (CHAT_DND_ALLOWED: the people whose calls still ring on do not disturb, [{userId, name}], store#DndAllowed), and statusPresets (CHAT_STATUS_PRESETS, a JSON list of {emoji, text, clearAfter}: minutes, today, week or 0 for never; five presets until the user changes them; the account menu's status dialog, WebrootChat.js, reads the same preference).
Save the chat preferences of ChatSettings (get#ChatPrefs names them); a preference not given stays. The do not disturb hours are both set (HH:mm) or both cleared.

parameter.name: saveFlags
parameter.description: The form has the check boxes, so an empty one is N

service.description: Add a person to the current user's do not disturb allowed list (action add), or take one off it (remove): CHAT_DND_ALLOWED, userIds joined by commas, which the framework's call ring reads (org.moqui.chat.ChatPushServices.filter#RingUsers, plans/Comms-Messaging.md §7.2 rule 4): on do not disturb a call from a person on it still rings the user's phones. At most 50 people; oneself is not on it.
Add a status preset (emoji, text, clearAfter) at the end of the list, or remove the one at index.

Set the current user's status text and emoji from the preset at index (org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.set#UserStatus), clearing after its minutes, at the end of today or of this week (Sunday) in the user's time zone, or never.

Put the current user's default notification level (CHAT_NOTIFY_DEFAULT) on every room the user is in but the direct ones (ChatSettings, Apply to my rooms). Each room on its own: one that fails is logged and the rest go on.

The do not disturb hours (ChatSettings; a ServiceJob every five minutes): a user whose CHAT_DND_FROM and CHAT_DND_TO window, in the user's time zone, holds now and whose status is online is put on do not disturb, noted in CHAT_DND_AUTO; once the window is over a status this put on do not disturb goes back to online (a status the user changed in between stays). A window from 22:00 to 07:00 runs over midnight. Each user on their own (a status in its own transaction): one that fails is logged and the rest go on.

Internal: a room list as the rail shows it, each room with url (its Chat link, under comms_app_root) and, for a record room, record {visible, title, typeLabel, url, icon, entity, id} from the record-lookup providers (lookup#Records info). A record no provider answers for, or the user no longer sees, keeps the room's name.

What the Chat screen and the tray's Chat tab start with: me {userId, username, name, partyId, bridgeAdmin (ChatBridgeAdmin: the room settings map the room to bridges)}, the preferences (get#ChatPrefs, with recordLink: an app files messages on its records), the user's rooms (org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.find#Rooms, pinned first, then by the last event, decorate#Rooms) up to limit, and the unread and mention totals.
Rooms as find#Rooms finds them (filter, searchText, includeJoinable for Browse rooms), decorated as the rail shows them.

A room as the room view opens it: the room (org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.get#Room, which refuses a room the user may not read) with displayName and its record (decorate#Rooms), the user's member row and access, the members, and the first page of its timeline (get#TimelinePage: the latest events, or those around aroundSeq).

A page of a room's timeline (org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.get#Timeline: beforeSeq, afterSeq, aroundSeq, a thread by threadRootEventSeq, or pinnedOnly) with userNames, the names of the users its events name (senders, reactions, the users of membership and system events, a thread's last replier, a forward's sender, a poll's voters), so the client words those rows. eventSeq gives that one event.

The @ mention list of a room's composer: the room's members whose name has the term, and in a public room (where anyone may be mentioned) the other users too (org.moqui.comms.CommsServices.search#Users), as [{id (the userId), label}]; the user is left out. First @room (id @room: every member), for a moderator or owner, or anyone in a room of 20 members or fewer, as the framework's send#Message takes it. A room the user may not read answers no one.

A new room (org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.create#Room) from the New room and New direct message dialogs: roomTypeEnumId direct (one room per set of users: the existing one is answered), private or public (a name), with the members of memberUserIdList or the comma list memberUserIds; each member starts at their own default notification level (CHAT_NOTIFY_DEFAULT, which create#Room reads). encrypted true makes a direct or private room end-to-end encrypted, for good (C7); false makes it plain. Not given, the default (E2EE by default, plans/Comms-Messaging.md §6.5): a direct room answers the encrypted direct room of exactly these people when there is one, else the plain one when there is one, else a new room, encrypted when the user and every member have a crypto device in use (org.moqui.chat.ChatKeyServices.check#DevicesReady); a private room is encrypted on the same rule; a public room never. encrypted out says what the room is.

The room of a record, for a record's chat link: the record room the user may read (org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.get#Room by the record), or a new one the user makes on first use (create#Room of type record, named after the record as a record-lookup provider names it, which needs the user to see the record: the theme's STRT_RECORD_VISIBLE_SERVICE). A record the user may not see is "not found"; a room of the record kept for its members is refused by create#Room.

Join a room the user may join (a public room, or a record room whose record the user sees: org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.add#Member, which starts the membership at the user's default notification level).

actions.script: ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.add#Member').parameter('chatRoomId', chatRoomId).call()

service.description: Send a message from the composer (org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.send#Message, as the current user, a member of the room): its body (the m-rich-text light HTML with @ mentions), files uploaded to the room (chatAttachmentIds, comma separated, or chatAttachmentIdList), a reply or a thread, a forward (forwardOfChatRoomId and forwardOfEventSeq: the server makes the quote), and as its records the records its /qapps links name (lookup#Records links). The mention notifications link to the room (roomUrl). clientRef: a send tried again (the page's outbox) is answered with its first message, duplicate true. In an encrypted room (C7) the browser sends encrypted (the Megolm ciphertext) and mentionUserIdList in place of a body, and no records are looked up.

actions.script: const ids = Array.from(chatAttachmentIdList || []).concat(chatAttachmentIds ? String(chatAttachmentIds).split(',') : []) .map((id) => String(id || '').trim()).filter((id) => id) const records = encrypted ? [] : ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.lookup#Records').parameters({operation: 'links', body: body || ''}).call().recordList const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.send#Message').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId, body: body || null, replyToEventSeq: replyToEventSeq ?? null, threadRootEventSeq: threadRootEventSeq ?? null, chatAttachmentIdList: ids, recordList: records, roomUrl: (System.getProperty('comms_app_root') || '/qapps/BasicComms') + '/Chat?chatRoomId=' + encodeURIComponent(chatRoomId), clientRef: clientRef || null, forwardOfChatRoomId: forwardOfChatRoomId || null, forwardOfEventSeq: forwardOfEventSeq ?? null, encrypted: encrypted || null, mentionUserIdList: mentionUserIdList || null}).call() reasonCode = out?.reasonCode || null if (ec.message.hasError()) return eventSeq = out.eventSeq; event = out.event; clientRef = out.clientRef; duplicate = !!out.duplicate

service.description: Store files for a message about to be sent in a room (org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.upload#Attachment, each in its own transaction): uploadList [{chatAttachmentId, fileName, contentType, fileSize}] and failedList [{fileName, error}]. One file that fails is logged and the others are kept; when none is stored the first error stays. uploadId in place of file is a file the client sent in chunks (ClientSyncServices.upload#Chunk).

The palette's Chat rooms group (design §13, the # prefix is the room switcher; Comms-Messaging §3, the group the palette shows first while Comms is the current app): the user's rooms and the public ones whose name or topic has the text (org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.find#Rooms), the latest first; then, for a text with three digits or more, the user's phone-number rooms (CrtExternal) whose number (the room's, or its bridge's) has those digits, of all the user's rooms. Each a row {title, subtitle, icon, url}, at most limit in all. moreUrl is the Chat screen. The people to message are search#PalettePeople, a group of their own that never leads.

The palette's People to message group (Comms-Messaging §3; no prefix, so it never leads and comes after Screens): the people the text finds (CommsServices.search#Users, so only those the user may reach) with no direct chat of the two of them with the user, each opening Chat with dm, which opens an unsaved message to them: the direct chat is made with the first message sent, so a quick Enter makes nothing another person sees. A person with a direct chat is the Chat rooms group's room.

The threads the current user is in across rooms (Comms-Messaging §3, the Threads view): each thread whose root the user sent or in which the user replied, with at least one reply, in a room the user can still read (get#RoomAccess, once a room), the one with the latest reply first. Items [{chatRoomId, roomName, roomTypeEnumId, threadRootEventSeq, startedByMe, rootSenderName, rootSnippet, replyCount, lastDate, lastEventSeq, lastUserId, lastUserName, lastSnippet, replierCount (the other people who replied, not the user), encrypted, and for an encrypted room the last reply's ciphertext (encryptedContent, encryptedEventSeq, encryptedSentDate)}]. Its own reply the user wrote last counts, and so does a thread it started that only it replied in. limit 1 to 100 (40); paged by cursor, an opaque text of the last thread's date, room and root; nextCursor null at the end. A reply is no activity of its own (ChatUserActivity), so nothing here notifies anyone.

The mail line of the Chat list (Comms-Messaging §3, §19.1): for each person the current user has a direct chat of the two of them with (a member of it now), that person's latest mail thread among the mail the user may read (get#EmailAccountAccess: owned accounts and those shared with the user, at any level), matched by the mail address of the person's user account only (§19.1: a mail account they own or share, an alias, is not theirs to be credited with): a message from that address, or with it in its To or Cc as a whole address. Drafts, Spam and Trash are left out. mailList: [{userId, chatRoomId, subject, date, threadKey (email:rootEmailMessageId), url (the thread in the Inbox under comms_app_root)}], one per person with mail. Read-only, in one query of the mail for all of them: the last 180 days, the latest 300 matching messages (a person whose mail is older than those has no line). An outside person (no user of this server) waits for unified contacts and has none.
